name: Widget
label: Widget
description: A titled section for a dashboard, a form, or settings, with rows, groups, a footer, an optional fold, and a board of columns.

props.name: title
props.description: The tile's heading. Also the section's accessible name, unless an `aria-label` is passed. Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which Widget does not expose.

props.name: count
props.description: A quiet figure after the title: how many rows the tile holds, how many are open.

props.name: action
props.description: Trailing header slot, opposite the title — a compact button, a link, a period label.

props.name: titleAs
props.description: Heading element for the title, so the tile takes its place in the page's outline.

props.name: description
props.description: A line of quieter text under the title, saying what the section holds. It also describes the section to a screen reader.

props.name: footer
props.description: A slot under the body, behind a divider: the section's actions (Save, Cancel), a total, a link to everything.

props.name: padding
props.description: The inset: `default` the tile's own, `compact` a step tighter for dense settings, `none` for a body that runs edge to edge (a table, a map) while the header and footer keep the default inset.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Let the reader fold the section away: the title becomes a button that shows and hides the body and footer, which leave the tab order and the accessibility tree while hidden.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether a collapsible section is open (controlled). Pair with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether a collapsible section starts open (uncontrolled). Defaults to true.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new open state when the reader folds or unfolds a collapsible section.

props.name: children
props.description: The tile's body: WidgetRows, WidgetGroups, a chart, a figure, a form, anything.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the count is written in, such as `ar-EG`. Defaults to `en-US`. This component can render from a Server Component, so it takes the prop alone and reads no LocaleProvider.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

props.name: columns
props.description: The most columns the board runs to. It folds to fewer as its own width narrows.

props.name: children
props.description: The Widgets on the board, in reading order: they fill the first column, then the next.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

props.name: label
props.description: The run's quiet label, e.g. "Waiting on you".

props.name: children
props.description: The rows in this run.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

props.name: title
props.description: The row's main line. Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which WidgetRow does not expose.

props.name: description
props.description: A quiet second line under the title: who, where, or how much.

props.name: leading
props.description: Leading mark — a StatusDot, a PixelAvatar, an Avatar, a Spinner, an icon. Decorative unless the element names itself.

props.name: meta
props.description: Trailing fact in the caption face: a date, an amount, a state.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders the row as a link to this URL.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component its links render with, such as Next.js's `Link`, so they
navigate through the app's router; a plain `<a>` when unset. This
component can render on the server, so it never reads a LinkProvider:
pass the prop even under one.

LinkComponent.description: A component that renders a link in place of a plain `<a>`, such as a router's.

LinkComponentProps.description:
The props a link component receives: every anchor attribute, the ref, and
an `href` that is always a string. Next.js's `Link` takes these as they
are; a router whose link takes `to` instead needs a one-line adapter:
`({ href, ...props }) => <RouterLink to={href} {...props} />`.
